parameters: My mommy is making food for everyone!
I want to help her catch fish, but I'm not a grownup yet!
@niko A few small fish are in the bottom of this jar.
This island has more moss covering than our village did.
Would've been nice to build a settlement here.
@niko These are filled with small, dried fish.
The land fragmentation is happening faster and faster now...
But...\.\. looks like the vines are slowing it down...
Our village was ransacked by the squares not long ago...
Most of us made it out alive, but we can't really go back anymore.
We won't last long now, will we?
The sun can't fix the squares...
The sun can't restore the land...
@magpie By the way... if you ever see a big guy with goggles and a cool helmet..
@magpie_smile Tell him the trader in the Glen said hi!
@magpie Also ask him if he has any more music boxes for trading.
@magpie_smile Sure am!\>\n\@magpie You here to trade?
@magpie_hm 'Cause if you are, then I got bad news for ya.
@magpie_hm A lot of my stuff is back at my cart, which was sadly abandoned when I was running for my life.
@magpie So my collection is...\.\. very limited right now.
@magpie_smile Managed to grab some of my favorite things before I left, though!
@niko Do you have anything like...\.\. gears?
@magpie_oh Gears?\.\. Like... the metal spinny things? \>\@magpie I don't think I have anything like that...
@magpie I do have this box thing that you can wind up and play a song.
@magpie_smile Yeah!\n\>\@magpie I bet there's lots of little metal bits in there!
@magpie_hm But I'm not sure if I want to trade it away...\>\nIt's one of my favorite things!
@magpie_oh Oh, what am I saying!\>\n\@magpie_smile You're the savior!
@magpie_hm Things have been getting bad around here lately.
@magpie_smile If I don't help you, I might not even be around much longer...
@magpie You need this to save the world, right?\>\nTake it.
The plant lady must be protecting us!
